details: Bitcoin climbed past $85,000 and Ethereum hit a nine-month high of $2,750 on September 21, defying ongoing global geopolitical tensions. This rally followed news of cancelled US strikes on Houthis in Yemen and upcoming US-China presidential talks, which aim to extend a trade truce and potentially ease energy supply concerns.
title: Crypto Market Surges Amid Geopolitical Tensions, US Diplomatic Hopes

details: Global oil prices continue to climb, with WTI crude trading above $100 per barrel, driven by ongoing geopolitical uncertainties, including conflicts in the Middle East and the Russia-Ukraine war. Diesel prices in the US have surpassed $6.50 a gallon, contributing to broader inflation fears. This sustained energy cost pressure is prompting market caution and may influence central bank monetary policy.
title: Rising Oil Prices Fuel Inflation Concerns as Geopolitical Risks Persist
